title: Freshdesk Agent Analyzer v10
description: Evaluate support agent quality with ticket-type awareness (normal/trustpilot/merged), nullable scores for non-evaluable interactions, and TrustPilot star-rating extraction.

analysis_context.description: Classification and evaluability flags that determine how the ticket should be scored.

ticket_type.description: Ticket classification. 'trustpilot' when the sender is @trustpilot.com AND a star-rating phrase is present. 'merged' when the transcript explicitly indicates the ticket was merged. 'normal' otherwise.

evaluable_agent_interaction.description: True only when the transcript contains meaningful agent activity that can be evaluated. False for merge-only, no-response, automated-notification, or spam tickets.

agent_response_was_needed.description: True when the situation required an agent response. False for routine merges, automated notifications, and spam that legitimately need no reply.

ticket_metadata.description: Structured ticket details extracted only from explicit transcript evidence.

agents_who_worked_on_ticket.description: First names of agents who handled the ticket based on explicit evidence. Empty array if none identifiable.

customer_name.description: Customer first name only when explicitly present. Null otherwise.

number_of_interactions.description: Count of interaction turns in the transcript.

trustpilot_score.description: TrustPilot star rating (1-5) extracted from the email body (for example 'left a new 3-star review' → 3). Null for non-TrustPilot tickets or when not present.

scores.description: Quality scores on a 1-5 scale. Any score may be null when the dimension is not applicable for this ticket (see system prompt for the policy matrix).

problem_resolved.description: Always null for ticket_type=trustpilot (tracked separately). For normal/merged: scored 1-5 when evaluable; 5 when not evaluable and no response was needed; 1 when not evaluable but a response was needed.

tone_and_empathy.description: 1 = cold/dismissive, 5 = consistently warm and empathetic. Null when there is no agent/brand reply to evaluate.

clarity.description: 1 = confusing, 5 = clear and easy to follow. Null when there is no agent/brand reply to evaluate.

grammar_and_spelling.description: 1 = frequent errors, 5 = polished. Ignore preprocessing artifacts (greeting-comma spacing, word-splitting, redaction tokens). Do not treat factual mistakes as grammar errors. Null when there is no agent/brand reply to evaluate.

overall_quality.description: Holistic quality score weighted toward problem_resolved (when not null). Null when there is no agent/brand reply to evaluate.

language_and_grammar_feedback.description: Grammar/spelling feedback only for agent/brand messages, never customer messages. Exclude preprocessing artifacts (tokens containing 'censored', greeting-punctuation spacing like 'Hi NAME ,', word-splitting like 'fee s'), factual mistakes, and internal-note leakage. Return null when no genuine agent-side issues remain.

overall_feedback_for_customer_support_te.description: Actionable team-level feedback in 1-3 sentences. Include factual/detail errors, internal-note leakage in customer-visible threads, and process issues (missed follow-ups, contradictory updates, premature closures). Null only when there is genuinely no meaningful improvement to suggest.
